title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
summary: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. title: Molecular structure breaks universality in screening behavior of electrolyte solutions
summary: Electrostatic screening is one of the most fundamental phenomena in electrolyte solutions. summary: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success. title: Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth
summary: Predictive coding networks perform credit assignment through an energy minimization process.
